name: Induced Subgraph and Ego-Network Extraction
problem_statement: Extract the graph induced by an explicit vertex set or by vertices within a hop radius of declared seeds.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: vertices_or_seeds
problem_inputs.description: Explicit selected vertices or ego centers.

required_outputs.name: subgraph
required_outputs.description: Selected vertices and every input edge whose endpoints are selected.

required_outputs.name: vertex_mapping
required_outputs.description: Mapping between output-local and original identifiers.

solution_semantics.objective: Preserve the induced graph on the specified or discovered vertex set.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact extraction, preserving edge identities and properties.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: The vertex set equals the declared selection or bounded BFS result.
Every and only input edge with both endpoints selected is returned.
edge_cases: Empty selection produces an empty graph.

correctness: The vertex set equals the declared selection or bounded BFS result.
Every and only input edge with both endpoints selected is returned.
